text: Signed by the Scorchers, his first BBL deal. The 20-year-old WA fast bowler took four wickets in the Sheffield Shield season opener against Queensland.
Cut his left hand on the evening of his comeback game for WA. He is seeing a hand specialist to find out how bad it is and when he can play again.

George Bailey said Smith won't be medically cleared until he returns from New York around 14 to 15 Nov, and plans to play Sheffield Shield round five from 22 Nov. Australia's squad for the NZ Tests will be named after Shield round four, which starts 11 Nov.
Not in England's 15-player Test squad for South Africa (17 Dec to 7 Jan), so he has no Test clash with BBL|16.
Not in England's 15-player Test squad for South Africa (17 Dec to 7 Jan), which Joe Root captains. That leaves him free for the whole Strikers season.
Named in the England Lions 50-over squad for three games in South Africa (1 to 6 Dec), which end before BBL|16. He isn't in the Lions red-ball squad, whose four-day games run to 21 Dec.

Returned from a back injury that kept him out of the WA side for 20 months, taking 3-29 off 10 overs at up to 145kph against England at the WACA. WA coach Beau Casson says he could play Sheffield Shield before the BBL if he gets through the next few weeks, but WA won't take risks with him.
Named in England's T20I squad for the five-match series in Australia (21 Nov to 2 Dec), which ends before BBL|16 starts.
Signed by the Strikers as a hard-hitting left-handed batter. Tim Paine didn't say where he'll bat.
Ruled out of BBL|16 with a shoulder injury.
Signed to replace Behrendorff. Misses the Chennai opener (12 Dec v Scorchers) for ILT20 with Dubai Capitals, likely available after that.

Retired from international, first-class and List A cricket, so no national duty clashes with BBL|16; his Stars contract runs to 2027-28. He chose a knee injection and eight weeks of rehab to be ready for the BBL rather than chase a place in the England T20Is.
In Australia's Test squad in South Africa and opened in the Cape Town decider. Likely to be picked for the NZ Tests from 9 Dec, which overlap BBL|16; that squad isn't named yet.
In Australia's Test squad in South Africa and played the Cape Town decider. Likely to be picked for the NZ Tests from 9 Dec, which overlap BBL|16; that squad isn't named yet.

Scans confirmed a cervical facet joint injury from the South Africa Tests. Cricket Australia expects him to be available for the home Tests against New Zealand, so he's still likely to miss BBL games for them.
Released from Australia's Test squad in South Africa after passing 10 once in four innings. cricket.com.au says he could come back into contention for the home Tests against New Zealand.
Opened for WA in the One-Day Cup (63 v Queensland, 14 v NSW). The Scorchers' other keeping option alongside Aneurin Donald.
Keeper-batter signed with full availability while Josh Inglis is uncontracted. Could open with Zak Crawley, depending on where Mitchell Marsh bats.
Primed to return from his shoulder injury.
Full availability including finals, despite an SA20 contract with MI Cape Town (SA20 starts 17 Jan).
Signed for the Hurricanes' first 8 matches (to 12 Jan), then SA20 with Sunrisers Eastern Cape. Misses the 14 and 17 Jan games.
Back-to-back One-Day Cup centuries for Queensland, batting at No. 3.
Opened for Tasmania (71 off 56) only because Mitchell Owen was with Australia A, and said "I don't know if it suits me". A weak signal.
Misses the Heat's first three matches (15, 17, 21 Dec) for family reasons; expected back for Boxing Day v Sixers.
Covers Tom Curran for 15, 17 and 21 Dec only, then returns to Auckland.
Bought by MI Emirates at the ILT20 auction (ILT20 runs to 20 Dec). The Renegades' "full season" came the day before; Mustafizur is skipping the opener for the same clash.
Contracted to Desert Vipers for ILT20 (to 20 Dec), though the Scorchers later said full availability.
Contracted to Abu Dhabi Knight Riders for ILT20 (to 20 Dec). The Stars haven't said whether he misses round 1.
Contracted to Sharjah Warriorz for ILT20 (to 20 Dec) and Sunrisers for SA20 (from 17 Jan). The Stars haven't said anything on either.
Contracted to Dubai Capitals for ILT20 (to 20 Dec). The Stars haven't said whether he misses round 1.
Contracted to MI Emirates for ILT20 (to 20 Dec). The Sixers haven't said whether he misses round 1.
Contracted to Joburg Super Kings for SA20 (from 17 Jan). No word on a clash.
Takes the top-order and keeping spot left by Tim Seifert. Batting position not stated. Will Sutherland named as captain.
Full availability including finals.
Takes over the gloves after Matthew Wade's retirement, available all season. Tipped to open with Mitchell Owen (not confirmed).
Retired from Tests, so available all season. Named a prime candidate for designated batter (bats, doesn't field or bowl). Heat captaincy still undecided.
Signed as an opener; a second keeping option alongside Josh Philippe. The same report says Steve Smith is likely to miss the tournament for international duty.
Left out of Australia's Test squad for South Africa after Matt Renshaw replaced him in August, so he's no longer expected to miss BBL games for the NZ Tests.
Available for the whole campaign. Tim Paine says he's "made to open" and will bat in the top three, and expects him to bowl in all phases. Matt Short may drop to No. 3.
Signed for SA20 (Pretoria Capitals), but released only after the Strikers' BBL|16 season ends, finals included.
Signed for SA20 (Sunrisers Eastern Cape), but released only after the Scorchers' BBL|16 season ends, finals included.
Sixers captaincy vacant after Henriques; Jack Edwards and Jordan Silk named as candidates. No appointment yet.

New designated player rule: each side may name one designated batter (bats only, can't field or bowl) and one designated fielder (fields and may keep, can't bowl) before the toss. Optional, men's BBL only.
Moises Henriques retired from the BBL and stepped down as Sixers captain.
